User: Let's say quality to price ratio.
Agent: So, for you, good value in fast food comes down to the quality you receive for the price you pay.

Now, let's move on to some other aspects of your fast-food choices. Compared to your last fast-food order, what changed today, if anything? Please pick the biggest driver and explain if it was your mood, cravings, schedule, budget, health goals, social plans, or convenience.
